p016: Stop use immediately if it causes flatness, anhedonia, emotional blunting, new depression, agitation, insomnia, dizziness, palpitations, nausea, loose stools, diarrhea, or increased craving. Do not attempt to “push through” numbness (if agmatine makes the world more gray, it is the wrong tool for that phase).
p017: Uridine & 5-HTP Warning for Psychedelic Users: Not to be used as “trip enhancers” (these are repair-oriented levers that can change brain sensitivity quickly). 5-HTP is a direct serotonin precursor, and therefore serotonergic: do not combine with SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs, linezolid, lithium, tramadol, methadone, fentanyl, DXM, MDMA, St. John’s wort, SAM-e, L-tryptophan, or other serotonin-raising stacks without clinician review. Use extra conservatively around ayahuasca and/or harmalas (MAO-A inhibition can amplify serotonin load), and iboga and/or ibogaine (ibogaine and noribogaine interact with serotonin transport biology, and already carry serious cardiac and neurological risk).
p085: Side effects / stop signs: Most common is the “choline headache” or spaced-out brain fog (if UMP accelerates membrane synthesis while choline availability is low, the system can feel under-supplied). Other stop signs include insomnia, jitteriness, racing thoughts, irritability, emotional flatness, nausea, stomach cramps, or loose stools. Stop if it makes you wired, numb, or weirdly irritable, and do not push through.
